admit_rank.obligation: Admit exactly 1..=32 with no allocation, returning RankOutOfRange otherwise. This new common guard precedes convenience constructor allocations.

FusionTable::new.obligation: Admit rank before allocating default name strings; pass names and multiplicities to with_names. Invalid-rank requests allocate no constructor-owned heap storage.

FusionTable::with_names.obligation: Admit rank first, then exactly rank cubed multiplicities, then exactly rank names; own a raw shaped table. This constructor alone does not validate fusion-ring laws.

FusionTable::from_array.obligation: Admit const R before flattening the caller-supplied stack array; preserve the original row-major order and ordinary constructor behavior on admitted R.

FusionRing::z_n.obligation: Admit the cyclic modulus via pointed/AbelianGroup before generating names; preserve accepted default names for n=2..32 and legacy refusal of n=0,1.

FusionRing::su2_level.obligation: checked_add the level-plus-one rank; return typed Overflow for usize::MAX, preserve the zero-level/rank error and admit levels 1..31 before allocation. For admitted i,j<=k, i+j<=2*k proves the high-limit subtraction exact without saturation.

unique_dual.obligation: Scan labels b ascending for the unique nonzero unit coefficient in a*b; require exactly one occurrence of multiplicity one, preserving the first failing a.

dual_labels.obligation: Collect unique duals in a order, then verify the same involution check as before; no acceptance predicate or error priority changes.

associativity_defect_at.obligation: Evaluate both checked-u128 sums at one (a,b,c,d), returning the same mismatch or overflow witness with identical operands.

associativity_defect_for_pair.obligation: For fixed (a,b), scan c then d ascending and stop at the first outcome defect.

first_associativity_defect.obligation: Scan a then b ascending and ask the pair helper for c,d; this preserves the complete original lexicographic defect ordering.

reciprocity_defect_for_pair.obligation: For fixed (a,b), compute the same dual fallbacks once and find the first violating c. No invalid-dual fallback semantics changes.

first_reciprocity_defect.obligation: Scan a then b ascending and report the first c witness from the pair helper.

rational_fusion_matrix.obligation: Factor the identical checked label lookup, integer fusion matrix and integer-to-rational map into one reusable conversion.

global_dimension_squared.obligation: Accumulate the same ordered sum of N_a*N_a_star in exact rational matrices, then call the unchanged characteristic-polynomial and root providers.

verlinde_value.obligation: Compute the same x-ordered scalar sum and final d_inverse multiplication for one (a,b,c). Field/scalar dependencies and coefficient conversion assumptions remain unreviewed at the full ring level.

collect_verlinde_pair.obligation: For fixed (a,b), scan c ascending, compute each full scalar value before checked coefficient embedding and append the same mismatch witnesses into the existing output vector.

verlinde_defects.obligation: Preserve shape, d_inverse and first-row inverse admission order, then scan a,b and delegate c to the pair helper. No per-pair output vector allocation.

fill_su2_product.obligation: For admitted k/rank/i/j, fill the same low..high labels of correct parity in the existing row-major slice; no intermediate allocation.

rational_sum_specification.domain: Any finite slice of raw Ratio<i64> values and raw Ratio<i64> total. Every used denominator must be nonzero. Negative entries and cancellation remain admitted; acceptance concerns only the aggregate, not physical simple-object dimensions.
behavior: Reject a zero total denominator before constructing a rational. Lift signed numerator and denominator separately to BigInt and normalize exactly in BigRational.
Reject a nonpositive exact total. Otherwise accumulate each ratio in BigRational, rejecting any zero entry denominator before its rational construction.
Return true exactly for a well-formed list whose exact sum equals the strictly positive total. No i64 arithmetic is used to combine values, and no saturation or floating-point rounding occurs.
The public signature and boolean refusal style are preserved. Individual negative entries may participate in a positive sum; no per-entry physical dimension validation is claimed.

invariant_arguments: For rank r in 1..32, r cubed<=32768, so table sizes and flattened indices are bounded before construction. The new guard itself is allocation-free and reaches every convenience path before its allocations. Caller-provided names, multiplicity vectors and arrays already exist and are outside this constructor-owned allocation claim.

For SU2 accepted k<=31 and rank=k+1, all i,j<=k imply i+j<=2*k; direct natural subtraction is exact and all intermediate usize products fit the compiled platform. The pre-admission k+1 has an explicit overflow error instead of a panic or wrap.

A nonzero signed i64 denominator/numerator pair embeds exactly into arbitrary integers then into their normalized rational quotient, including i64::MIN and negative denominators. By induction over the list, each successful sum prefix equals its mathematical rational sum; large cancellation cannot overflow fixed-width storage.

The sum predicate has finite O(N) rational additions, but operand bit lengths grow with the rational input; no constant memory/time or whole-fusion-law guarantee is claimed. Compiler, num_bigint/num_rational, allocator and external path dependencies remain TCB.
